question.prompt: At the end of \(1994\) Walter was half as old as his grandmother. The sum of the years in which they were born is \(3838.\) How old will Walter be at the end of \(1999?\)

solutions.explanation:
At the end of a calendar year, a person's age in completed years is that year minus the person's birth year. Subtracting the sum of the two birth years from two copies of \(1994\) therefore gives their combined age at the end of \(1994\):
\[
1994+1994-3838=150.
\]
Walter was half as old as his grandmother, so their ages were in the ratio \(1:2\). The total of \(150\) years consists of three equal shares, with Walter having one share. His age was thus
\[
150\div3=50.
\]
From the end of \(1994\) to the end of \(1999\), five years pass. Walter will be \(50+5=55\) years old, choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
solutions.title: Find the total age and divide it
Divide the total age in a ratio
